tokens.title: Visual system
tokens.subtitle: Ticket A2 · token verification page
tokens.intro: This page is not the product; it is a check sheet. Every value comes from the tokens in globals.css, so it is easy to see whether they match the visual system spec. E1 replaces this page entirely.
tokens.colorNote: Four materials, not four colours. Switch day/night at the top right — everything should change together.
tokens.ratioNote: A hard rule. More than one cell of cinnabar is a mistake, not a style choice.
tokens.typeNote: Song for the frame, Spectral alongside it, Noto Sans TC for utility only. Line height 1.95, 32–40 characters per line, never embolden Chinese.

specimen.lead: Your Life Palace falls in Shen.
specimen.body: Zi Wei Dou Shu carries the structure of a life across twelve palaces. It speaks of tendencies, not conclusions.
specimen.sm: This passage is inference, not assertion.

tokens.layoutNote: Text block 690px, head margin 104px, foot margin 64px (8:5). The frame below is the real text-block width.
tokens.motionNote: Three panels below animate in. All start from a visible state: with JS off, or reduced motion on, the content is complete — it simply does not move.
tokens.motionOneNote: Scrolling back up does not replay it.
tokens.motionThreeNote: 900ms in — three times a typical site.

cast.muluNote1: These chapters are set before you write in your birth.
cast.muluNote2: Once you do, they will fill in.
cast.timeHint: Use the clock time on your birth certificate. We handle daylight saving ourselves.
cast.slotsLoading: Working out the hours of that day…
cast.noHourComfort: Without the hour we can't place the Life palace, so this book will wait on your shelf with a dotted spine — a book waiting for its hour. It is usually on the birth certificate, and family can often remember. Add the hour and the book is complete.
cast.awaitBody1: The year, month and day are in place; the Life palace is still waiting for the hour. The book will stay on your shelf with a dotted spine.
cast.awaitBody2: Add the hour and the book is complete.
